content:
Maya Singh: FYI spotted weird credits hitting reseller RSL-42 today. They got a -$3,210.00 line on invoice MKT-9001. Did a pricing experiment leak into reseller pricing?
Carlos Ortiz: looking. I see `pricing_flag=experiment/early_access=true` on marketplace ingestion for march usage. That flag should only apply to direct customers, not partners.
billing-bot: ingestion event: invoice=MKT-9001 lines=42 total=-3210.00 USD. source=aws_marketplace_metering serviceRecordId=sr-77b3
Maya Singh: negative total means we issued a credit memo to the reseller. partners are upset. Who toggled the experiment?
FinOps (Ava): policy: credits >$1,000 require manual sign-off. This is >$3k so needs senior approval to reverse.
Carlos Ortiz: tracing shows the experiment mapping rule matched `tier_discount` then applied again at `reseller_discount` step so discount double-counted. Looks like a recent rule change from yesterday.
PartnerOps (Marketplace): partner says they did not request credits. They provided usage file sr-77b3 with expected gross $4,500. The -$3,210 seems to be a net after double discounts.
Maya Singh: tentative plan: 1) prevent further experiment rollouts to marketplace/reseller channel; 2) reverse credit memo to restore original charges; 3) run reconciliation to ensure invoice totals match usage file; 4) track root cause ticket.
Carlos Ortiz: I've disabled the experiment flag for `marketplace_*` in feature-store. diff: `- enable: marketplace_*`, `+ enable: marketplace_direct_only`. Pushed at 2026-06-12T09:40Z.
billing-bot: feature toggle change detected: experiment/early_access disabled for marketplace_* by carlos.
Maya Singh: Sam from PartnerOps asked for a remediation timeline. We need FinOps approval to create a reversal invoice (we'll create a charge-back).
FinOps (Ava): I can approve reversal charges up to $5k for operational errors. Approved: create reversal charge for $3,210 and notify partner. Document reason: accidental double discount due to experiment flag. :white_check_mark:
Carlos Ortiz: creating reversal with `INSERT INTO invoices (invoice_id,amount,status,notes) VALUES ('MKT-9001-RV1',3210.00,'posted','reversal of erroneous credit due to experiment flag');`
billing-bot: reversal invoice MKT-9001-RV1 posted, status=posted, link=https://billing.internal/invoices/MKT-9001-RV1
PartnerOps (Marketplace): partner requested we include detailed line breakdown and the original usage rows. Uploaded to ticket #5205.
Maya Singh: running reconciliation script against partner usage file sr-77b3. sample rows: `acct-44,usage=250000,amount=4500.00` and applied discounts should have produced net 4500 not negative.
Carlos Ortiz: also adding a monitoring alert to detect negative invoice totals for resellers: `alert if invoice_total < 0 AND channel='reseller'`
billing-bot: alert rule created.
FinOps (Ava): confirm when reversal posts and we'll notify revenue ops to update GL.
Maya Singh: reversal confirmed posted and GL journal queued: `INSERT INTO gl_entries (id,account,amount,desc) VALUES ('gl-9101','accounts_receivable',3210.00,'reversal of credit MKT-9001');`
PartnerOps (Marketplace): partner confirmed receipt and will update downstream billing systems. They're asking for post-mortem.
Carlos Ortiz: opening post-mortem ticket #5206 for experiment rollout validation gap. Root cause: feature toggle scoping error. Mitigation: add preflight check and integration test to block `marketplace_*` scopes.
Maya Singh: closing loop  I'll send summary to finance-announce and update ticket #5205. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
